title: Brian Schottenheimer: I don't worry about George Pickens's drops, he'll be just fine

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer: I don't worry about George Pickens's drops, he'll be just fine
sources.description: Among the reasons why the Cowboys lost 28-20 to the Giants in Week 1 were a pair of dropped passes by wide receiver George Pickens.
